records.question: 各品类商品销售额（不含运费）前十名是哪些？
records.sql_text: SELECT p.product_category AS product_category, SUM(oi.price) AS item_gmv FROM v_o_order_items AS oi JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN v_o_products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.product_category ORDER BY item_gmv DESC LIMIT 10

detail.binding_disclosure: 商品金额取明细行 price，不含运费

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT pr.product_category AS category,
       SUM(i.price) AS item_gmv
FROM v_o_order_items AS i
JOIN v_o_orders AS o   ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN v_o_products AS pr ON pr.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY pr.product_category
ORDER BY item_gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

records.question: 各州的配送延迟率是多少？
records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = %(status_delivered)s AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_state ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC LIMIT 100

detail.binding_disclosure: 按订单归属，分子分母同一批 delivered 单

gold.gold_sql:
SELECT o.customer_state AS state,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate
FROM v_o_orders AS o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY delivery_late_rate DESC

records.sql_text: SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS aov, (SELECT SUM(p2.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id), 0) FROM v_o_orders AS o2 JOIN v_o_payments AS p2 ON o2.order_id = p2.order_id WHERE NOT o2.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS overall_aov FROM v_o_orders AS o JOIN v_o_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state HAVING SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) > (SELECT SUM(p3.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o3.order_id), 0) FROM v_o_orders AS o3 JOIN v_o_payments AS p3 ON o3.order_id = p3.order_id WHERE NOT o3.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) ORDER BY aov DESC LIMIT 100

detail.binding_disclosure: 分子分母同过滤，避免与订单量口径漂移

       SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS aov
FROM v_o_payments AS p
